title: Annotated List

illustrates.quote: Annotations are explanatory notes or comments about an entry. Use the nested list format. (See Sample 8-17: Annotated List on page 8-30.)

blocks.features: Two room entries, each with a two-line indented annotation describing its location and contents.

items.text: Located on the fourth floor of the Taylor Hall on the Lower Campus
Classroom with 25 desks, blackboard, projector, screen, and internet connection.
Located on the second floor of Brown Hall on the Middle Campus
Lecture hall with 100 seats, podium, microphone, projector, screen, and internet connection

blocks.features: A trailing braille page-number code at the right edge of braille line 1 ("#hi" = h,i = 8,9 = page 89), with no print-side counterpart in this excerpt — same class of gap as sample-8-16’s/sample-8-06’s reference codes.

print.printFeatures: Plain nested list; room number unindented, its two-line annotation indented one level, no bullets/numbers.

braille.notes: Main entries ('Room 257'/'Room 456') begin cell 1 (line 1 carries a trailing reference code '#hi' after 'Room 257'); each annotation begins cell 3 as a nested-list subentry, per 8.9's instruction to use the nested-list format for annotations.

uncertain: The trailing reference code '#hi' on line 1 was transcribed literally; its exact meaning was not determined (see the equivalent note on sample-8-16).
